vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: jisu-news
Version: 1.0.2

The skill bundle is a legitimate implementation for fetching news via the Jisu News API. The Python script (news.py) correctly handles API requests using the requests library, manages the API key through environment variables, and contains no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or obfuscation. The SKILL.md documentation provides clear, non-manipulative instructions for the AI agent.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and requested credential (JISU_API_KEY) match its stated purpose of calling the Jisu News API; nothing unexpected or disproportionate was found.

dimensions.detail: Name and description match the behavior: the skill queries Jisu News endpoints and requires the JISU_API_KEY. Required binary (python3) and primaryEnv are appropriate.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to run the included Python script to fetch channels or news JSON; the script only reads JISU_API_KEY from the environment and makes HTTPS requests to api.jisuapi.com. It does not read other files or exfiltrate data to unrelated endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only) and the code is included. The script imports the Python 'requests' library but the skill metadata does not list Python package dependencies or an install step; agents/platforms must ensure 'requests' is available or the script will fail.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only JISU_API_KEY is required and used; the scope of environment access is minimal and justified by the API calls.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not always:true and does not request persistent or cross-skill configuration changes. It runs on demand and does not attempt to modify other skills or system settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be what it claims: it uses your JISU_API_KEY to call Jisu News API endpoints and returns news lists. Before installing: (1) ensure you trust the JISU API provider and are willing to expose a dedicated JISU_API_KEY to the agent; (2) confirm the runtime has the Python 'requests' package installed (pip install requests) or the script will error; (3) be aware the skill fetches third-party content—respect copyright and check API quotas/permissions for the key; (4) because the agent may invoke skills autonomously by default, don't reuse a broad-scoped secret in JISU_API_KEY (use a key limited to this API).
